jobs.title: Chief, Investigations [Open to internal and external applicants]
jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

The Office of Audit and Investigations (OAI) reports to the Administrator and is responsible for internal audit and investigations services to UNDP and its affiliated entities. It is comprised of the Audit Section and the Investigations Section. The Investigations Section (OAI/IS) is charged with conducting misconduct investigations and with compliance review of UNDP’s social and environmental policies and procedures and has sole responsibility for the conduct of all investigations within UNDP.

In its performance of misconduct investigations, OAI/IS addresses allegations of misconduct, such as fraud, theft and embezzlement, corruption, abuse of privileges and immunities, sexual exploitation and sexual abuse, workplace harassment and abuse of authority, retaliation, or other acts or omissions in conflict with the general obligations and policies that govern the conduct of UNDP staff and other personnel. OAI also investigates allegations of fraud and other financial irregularities committed by contractors, implementing partners and other third parties, deemed to be detrimental to UNDP. OAI’s capacity includes specialized Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment (SEAH), Information Technology (IT) forensics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), data analytics, and proactive investigations units and resources.

As the provider of a professional, secure and reliable mechanism that responds to and addresses reports of possible misconduct or fraud, OAI is the sole and centralized custodian of a unique dataset of information regarding possible irregularities across UNDP’s operations. As such, OAI has a role to play in providing real-time and data-supported advice to management on wrongdoing risks, controls, lessons and mitigation strategies, and to use this information to develop intelligence-led detection, diversion and proactive investigation strategies that prevent and deter wrongdoing without relying solely on received reports.

OAI conducts misconduct investigations in accordance with the Uniform Principles and Guidelines for Investigations endorsed by the 10th Conference of International Investigators, with the UNDP Legal Framework for Addressing Non-Compliance with the United Nations Standards of Conduct, and with the OAI Investigation Guidelines.

OAI’s Investigations Section has established Units, under the supervision of Investigation Chiefs, that are comprised of (a) functionally specialized teams and (b) regionally focused misconduct investigation teams. This structure facilitates the accessibility of specialized functions to the entirety of the Investigations Section under the guidance and leadership of a manager and ensures close and rigorous oversight of investigation matters, also under the appropriate level of leadership.

Duties and Responsibilities

As the Chief, Investigations, Unit 2, which is comprised of Misconduct Investigations regional teams and the Sexual Misconduct Team (SMT), the incumbent is charged with leading OAI’s misconduct investigations in Central and West Africa (CWA) and East and Southern Africa (ESA).

The Chief, Investigations, Unit 2, also operates within a cross-functional model to provide specialized investigation and policy support for Sexual Misconduct matters.

The Investigation Chief functionally reports to the Deputy Director (Investigations).

UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNDP personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.

1. Leads Workplace Culture and Teambuilding

- Leads by example, setting the tone for the Unit. Consciously build a supportive, collegiate and positive team culture within the Unit, while supervising staff, promoting best practices, and fostering professional development.

- Works collectively and collaborates professionally with peers and the Head of Investigations to provide thought leadership and constructive challenge to ensure the Office is a dynamic, high-performing, reflective unit that keeps pace with best practice.

- As part of the management team, actively engages and promotes discussions aimed at continued improvement of the Office and the investigation function, ensuring highest impact and efficient, effective practices.

- Supervises staff and non-staff personnel in the Investigations Section and provides clear, fair, supported, and balanced performance feedback and reviews.

- Engages productively, professionally, collaboratively and efficiently with peers, team members, and parties internal and external to the Section to problem-solve as necessary, seek solutions and achieve positive and impactful collective outputs.

- Actively employs management techniques that ensure balance in prioritizing quality output of a high standard and a healthy workplace culture.

- Supports the professional development of staff and/or recruit appropriate personnel to ensure the Unit has the optimal blend of skills necessary to deliver high quality investigations and advisory work.

2. Leads Investigations Management

- he Chief, Investigations, Unit 2 manages investigations teams and the respective caseload, ensuring timely, professional and resource-effective completion and reporting of investigative activity. Assumes accountability for achieving investigation objectives and results.

- Ensures that investigative activity is performed in accordance with international guidelines, relevant institutional policies, and OAI internal policy at a high standard through close oversight of investigative activity and output.

- Leads, manages, and motivates a diverse team based in multiple locations; upholds UNDP and OAI values; sets the right tone for the team; and creates a working environment and culture where everyone can achieve their best.

- Produces, reviews, and ensures the team’s production of, well-evidenced, high-quality reports to form the basis for disciplinary proceedings and/or for referrals to national authorities for criminal investigation and prosecution, as appropriate.

- Conducts regular case reviews to manage the investigation caseload, monitoring the status and timelines of each case.

- Ensures that all appropriate lines of inquiry are identified and pursued; investigation resources are used effectively and efficiently to factually determine the issues relevant to an investigation; and matters are closed as expediently and efficiently as appropriate.

- Provides senior investigation expertise and advice to investigators on all investigative activity, particularly on complex, high-priority and/or otherwise sensitive cases.

- Enhances investigations by leveraging IT forensics, financial forensics, analysis software, AI applications, internal data, open-source tools and information, while adhering to applicable information security and confidentiality principles.

- Ensures the appropriate collection, recording, handling, and securing of evidence.

- Ensures the application of specialist investigation services as and when appropriate (e.g., handwriting analysis, document examination, financial forensics).

- Oversees and, in exceptional circumstances, conducts professional, thorough and timely interviews of witnesses showing appropriate communications skills, accurate recording and verification of testimony using interpreters as required, in accordance with applicable Investigations Section policies.

- Oversees and, in exceptional circumstances, conducts professional, thorough and timely interviews of subjects in accordance with generally accepted best practice procedures in order to obtain reliable information relating to specific allegations of misconduct, while affording due process, in accordance with applicable Investigations Section policies.

- Oversees and, in exceptional circumstances, undertakes, as required, missions to UNDP offices worldwide, including areas with hazardous working conditions.

- Oversees, reviews, and, in exceptional circumstances, undertakes the drafting of investigation reports and other written output of a high standard that require minimal further editing and provide an objective and factual summary of the investigation, with soundly based conclusions and recommendations supported by all evidence obtained in the course of the investigation.

- Ensures accurate and timely maintenance and updating of information held in the investigative database, case files, and evidentiary records, as related to cases under incumbent’s oversight.

- Operates with a cross-functional approach by assisting other investigative units within OAI.

- Improves OAI's capacity to perform thorough and professional investigations through knowledge-sharing and training programs.

- Identifies and addresses underperformance, skills gaps, or conduct issues at first instance through coaching, feedback, and performance management measures, in accordance with UNDP procedures where required.

- Supports the professional development of team members through mentoring, on-the-job guidance, and contributions to performance assessments and development planning.

- Undertakes missions to UNDP offices worldwide, including areas with hazardous working conditions.

3. Ensures Effective Management of the Sexual Misconduct Team (SMT)

- Oversees and manages investigations into allegations of sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse within UNDP's operations.

- Ensures the overall management of the OAI SMT response.

- Oversees the investigation caseload, monitoring the status and timelines of each case

- Provides expert guidance to UNDP’s SMT, other OAI investigative teams, and institutional key stakeholders in handling sensitive cases of sexual misconduct.

- Liaises with the UNDP Sexual Misconduct Taskforce, the Office of Legal Services, the Office of Human Resources, the Ethics Office, and other relevant offices in UNDP, on matters related to SMT cases.

- Assesses the potential for sexual misconduct and other misconduct in UNDP offices and operations and provides advisory services to the relevant organizational units to mitigate emerging and actualized risks.

4. Provide leadership and management of high-quality client services, ensuring strategic coordination

- Maintains a role as a visible, active and accessible regional representative, including by liaising with senior officials within the region and bureau; sharing insights from the regional caseload with senior managers; receiving and considering feedback on investigation services; participating in regional or country level conferences or meetings to raise awareness of OAI services.

- Negotiates and liaises with officials from governments, national and international agencies, stakeholders, and partner organizations on investigation-related matters.

- Oversees planning of investigation missions as necessary with investigators, Country Office management, UNDP Security and other stakeholders.

- Liaises with the Office of Legal Services (OLS), the Ethics Office, the Procurement Support Office, operational units and Country Offices, the Social and Environmental Compliance Unit and other relevant business units in UNDP.

- Liaises with the investigation sections of other international organizations and with national anti-corruption and law enforcement agencies as appropriate.

5. Represents OAI, Risk Management and Facilitate Knowledge Management

- Represents OAI at the United Nations Representatives of Investigative Services(UNRIS), the Conference of International Investigators (CII), and other forums, as required.

- Contributes to the ongoing development of professional practices within OAI and UNDP’s management practice and stays abreast of developments in the investigation field.

- Participates in the implementation of his/her personal learning and training development plan.

- Provides testimony at relevant tribunals, as required and as appropriate relative to tasks overseen, performed, or over which the incumbent has qualification and expertise.

- Provides timely information to OAI senior management on investigation-related matters and ad-hoc assignments.

- Prepares risk-based information for dissemination to stakeholders at different levels in UNDP for continuous improvement of risk management.

- Implements and enforces appropriate measures to ensure handling of all investigation-related information in accordance with appropriate confidentiality requirements.

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Supervisory/Managerial Responsibilities: Supervision and performance management of Investigations Specialists, Investigations Analyst(s), Non-personnel, Interns

Competencies

Core:

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact.

- Think Innovatively: LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems.

- Learn Continuously: LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences.

- Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands.

- Act with Determination: LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results.

- Engage and Partner: LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter-agency collaboration.

- Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity.

People Management:

UNDP People Management Competencies can be found in the dedicated site.

Cross Functional and Technical:

- Investigation - Investigation management and investigative techniques: The ability to manage an investigation, choose avenues of inquiry and apply different techniques during an investigation, including investigative interviewing; seizure of documentary and electronic evidence; identification, collection, review and analysis of all types of evidence, including project, procurement and commercial business documentation and electronic communications; forensic analysis; verification site visits; open-source research.

- Investigation - Collection and analysis of evidence: Ability to extract and analyze all relevant types of evidence and be able to draw reasonable inferences and conclusions.

- Investigation - Investigative Interviewing: Ability to conduct investigative interviews with all types of investigation participants, including witnesses and subjects, using an approach tailored to the interviewee and the investigation.

- Investigation - Technology tools and applications for investigations: Ability to understand key application and system software, IT infrastructure, IT Control frameworks and the use of forensic investigation software.

- Business Management - System Thinking: Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system.

- Business Management - Portfolio Management: Ability to select, prioritise and control the organization's programmes and projects in line with its strategic objectives and capacity. Ability to balance the implementation of change initiatives with regular activities for optimal return on investment. Knowledge and understanding of key principles of project, programme, and portfolio management.

- Business Direction & Strategy - Business Acumen: Ability to understand and deal with a business situation in a manner that is likely to lead to a good outcome. Ability to make good judgments and quick decisions within such frameworks. Knowledge and understanding of the operational frameworks in the organization.

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

- Advanced university degree (master's degree or equivalent) in Investigations, Law, Management, Finance, or related field is required. Or

- A first level university degree (bachelor’s degree) in the fields of study mentioned above, in combination with an additional two (2) years of qualifying experience, which will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Experience:

- A minimum of 10 years (with master’s degree) or 12 years (with bachelor’s degree) of progressively responsible professional experience in the field of complex criminal and administrative investigations is required.

- Experience in conducting criminal and/or administrative investigations across multiple geographic locations and conducting quality assurance reviews and legal assessments in the field of investigations is required.

- Experience in supervising a team of investigators and managing a large and varied caseload of administrative or criminal investigations is required.

- Experience designing and executing risk assessment frameworks to manage and prioritize a high-volume portfolio of complex administrative, misconduct, fraud, corruption, sexual misconduct, or safeguarding investigations is desired.

- Experience providing strategic advice to senior leadership on sensitive investigative matters and organizational risk is desired.

- Experience in policy development through consultation and collaboration with institutional partners is desired.

- Experience working in an international investigations role, and in the role of a senior investigations manager is desired.

- Experience leading or supervising complex investigations into sexual misconduct, applying victim-centered methodologies, is desired.

- Experience conducting field-based investigations in complex, high-risk, or fragile/conflict-affected operational environments is desired.

- Proficiency in leveraging data analytics, digital evidence, artificial intelligence applications, and forensic resources to enhance investigative outcomes is desired.

- A professional certification in the field of national and international investigations is desired.

Language:

- Fluency in English is required.

- Working knowledge of another UN language is desired.

Equal opportunity

As an equal opportunity employer, UNDP values diversity as an expression of the multiplicity of nations and cultures where we operate and, as such, we encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply for roles in the organization. Our employment decisions are based on merit and suitability for the role, without discrimination.

UNDP is also committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all personnel are empowered to contribute to our mission, are valued, can thrive, and benefit from career opportunities that are open to all.

Sexual harassment, exploitation, and abuse of authority

UNDP does not tolerate harassment, sexual harassment, exploitation, discrimination and abuse of authority. All selected candidates, therefore, undergo relevant checks and are expected to adhere to the respective standards and principles.

Probation

For all new UNDP fixed term appointments (FTA), including for staff members being transferred or seconded to UNDP under the Inter-Organization Agreement concerning Transfer, Secondment or Loan of Staff, on an appointment of more than one year, continuation of the appointment beyond the initial 12 months is contingent upon the successful completion of a probationary period.

Right to select multiple candidates

UNDP reserves the right to select one or more candidates from this vacancy announcement. We may also retain applications and consider candidates applying to this post for other similar positions with UNDP at the same grade level and with similar job description, experience and educational requirements.

Use of AI by candidates

Applicants are invited to read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Scam alert

UNDP does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process. For further information, please see www.undp.org/scam-alert.

jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

The Regional Programme Management Support Unit (RPMSU) at the UNDP Bangkok Regional Hub (BRH) plays a central role in supporting the effective management, oversight, quality assurance, compliance, and performance monitoring of the Regional Programme (RP) and Regional Projects throughout the project lifecycle. RPMSU works closely with programme and project teams to ensure that regional initiatives are designed, implemented, monitored, and reported in accordance with UNDP Programme and Project Management (PPM) standards and corporate compliance requirement while promoting high-quality programme implementation and results delivery.

As BRH enters the implementation phase of the Regional Programme 2026–2029, there is an increasing need to strengthen evidence-based management, portfolio oversight, and proactive performance monitoring. At the same time, corporate requirements related to project transparency, data quality, risk management, quality assurance, results reporting, and audit readiness continue to expand, requiring greater consistency and accuracy in project data management and programme monitoring practices.

In responding to these needs, PMSU has led a series of initiatives under the Project Managers Peer Learning Network and the Regional Programme Digitalization and Automation Initiative to strengthen project management practices, improve access to programme management knowledge, and modernize RP monitoring systems. A key milestone of these efforts has been the development of the Regional Programme Performance Dashboard, which provides an integrated platform for monitoring regional programme delivery, pipeline management, portfolio performance, and management analytics through automated data integration and visualization tools.

To ensure sustainability and continuous improvement of these digital solutions, PMSU seeks a Regional Programme and Data Management Associate to support dashboard management, project data quality, transparency compliance, programme and project quality assurance, and regional project risk monitoring. The incumbent will work closely with Regional Project Managers and Programme Teams to strengthen Programme and Project Management and data management practices in corporate systems. The position will also support PMSU Programme Specialists in conducting RP compliance monitoring, programme and project quality assurance reviews, risk management exercises, and annual results reporting.

Duties and Responsibilities

The Regional Programme and Data Management Associate will work under the direct supervision of the Regional Programme Management Specialist. On the day-to-day basis, the incumbent will work closely with RBM Specialist and PA Coordinator as well as regional project team members and relevant Project Assistants / Associates to strengthen compliance with Programme and Project Management (PPM) requirements, improve data quality and transparency, support portfolio-level risk and quality reviews, and continuously enhance the effectiveness of the Regional Programme Performance Platform (RP³) as a management and decision-support tool.

Under the direct supervision of the Regional Programme Management Specialist, the Regional Programme and Data Management Associate will support PMSU in strengthening Regional Programme performance monitoring, project quality assurance, compliance oversight, and digitalization initiatives through the management of the Regional Programme Performance Dashboard and related data management systems.

The incumbent will perform the following functions:

A. Regional Programme and Project Database Management and Enhancement

- Serve as the focal point for the day-to-day management and maintenance of the Regional Programme Performance Dashboard;

- Monitor dashboard functionality, data synchronization, accessibility, and user experience to ensure reliable and timely performance reporting;

- Coordinate with ICT teams, data warehouse focal points, dashboard developers, and corporate system administrators to troubleshoot technical issues and improve dashboard functionality;

- Monitor project compliance with mandatory project setup and data management requirements reflected in the corporate Transparency Dashboard;

- Conduct periodic testing, validation, and quality reviews of dashboard data and analytics;

- Develop a set of data management guidelines (data governance) for both physical and electronic data including protocols for data entry, storage, security, and sharing, among others, to ensure data integrity and security;

- Develop a Data Quality Assessment (DQA) plan that sets the standards for data accuracy, consistency, and completeness—setting benchmarks and criteria for evaluating the quality of data;

- Develop data and digital products including, but not limited to, collection tools, dashboards, and reports, that are critical for accountability, transparency, and learning.

B. Regional Programme and Project (RP) Compliance, Risk Management and Quality Assurance

- Support RPMSU in monitoring compliance with UNDP Programme and Project Management (PPM) standards and procedures across the Regional Programme and Projects (RPs);

- Conduct regular RP compliance reviews and identify emerging compliance risks and implementation challenges;

- Monitor and track high-quality completion of project setup in Quantum in responding to PPM standards and corporate requirements;

- Support PMSU Programme Specialists in conducting programme and project quality assurance exercises throughout the project lifecycle;

- Review project management documentation and provide recommendations to improve compliance, project design quality, implementation effectiveness, and results reporting;

- Support PMSU in strengthening regional project risk management practices;

- Monitor regional projects risk treatments using the Regional Programme Risk Dashboard and other corporate systems;

- Conduct periodic reviews of regional project risk logs to assess quality, completeness and updated risk treatment measures.

C. RP Management and Implementation Support

- Support the management and improvement of digital technology solutions, including POCOMAS and relevant web- based project results management platforms, to enhance scalability and sustainability in line with UNDP digital standards;

- Support the regional programme and project evaluations and results monitoring as assigned;

- Provide administrative support to assigned projects and GPN thematic areas by maintaining internal expenditure systems, reviewing technical reports and payments for quality assurance, coordinating follow-up with relevant units, and ensuring timely corrective actions;

- Make preparations for external and internal programme / project audits, and support implementation of audit recommendations.

D. Capacity Development and Knowledge Management

- Provide day-to-day guidance and capacity-building support to regional project teams on: Use of the Regional Programme Performance Dashboard Transparency Dashboard requirements Project data quality management Programme and Project Management standards Risk management practices Quality assurance requirements Develop guidance notes, SOPs, FAQs, job aids, and training materials related to project compliance, data quality, risk management, and performance monitoring.

- Support PMSU learning initiatives, including the Project Managers Peer Learning Network and Digitalization and Automation Community of Practice;

- Document lessons learned and good practices from dashboard implementation, programme monitoring, compliance reviews, and quality assurance exercises.

Competencies

Core Competencies:

- Achieve Results: LEVEL 1: Plans and monitors own work, pays attention to details, delivers quality work by deadline.

- Think Innovatively: LEVEL 1: Open to creative ideas/known risks, is pragmatic problem solver, makes improvements.

- Learn Continuously: LEVEL 1: Open minded and curious, shares knowledge, learns from mistakes, asks for feedback.

- Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 1: Adapts to change, constructively handles ambiguity/uncertainty, is flexible.

- Act with Determination: LEVEL 1: Shows drive and motivation, able to deliver calmly in face of adversity, confident.

- Engage and Partner: LEVEL 1: Demonstrates compassion/understanding towards others, forms positive relationships.

- Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 1: Appreciate/respect differences, aware of unconscious bias, confront discrimination.

Business Development

jobs.description:
Tiered Approach

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:

- Tier 0 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026.

- Tier 1 : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments

- Tier 2 : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

<Le Département de la sûreté et de la sécurité (UNDSS) est chargé d’assurer la direction, le soutien opérationnel et la supervision du système de gestion de la sécurité des Nations Unies (UNSMS) à l’échelle mondiale. En tant que leader mondial en matière de principes de gestion des risques de sécurité, l’UNDSS permet la mise en œuvre sûre et efficace des programmes et activités des Nations Unies dans les environnements les plus complexes et les plus difficiles, tout en optimisant l’utilisation de ressources précieuses. À cette fin, les activités du Département s’inscrivent dans le cadre d’une mission claire : permettre au système des Nations Unies de mener à bien ses activités grâce à un leadership et à des solutions fiables en matière de sécurité.

Le recrutement d'un chauffeur pour le projet est donc une nécessité stratégique et opérationnelle pour garantir la réalisation effective des résultats du Département de la sûreté et de la sécurité (UNDSS) et la réalisation de ses objectifs. Il améliorera la rentabilité en réduisant la dépendance à l'égard de la location de véhicules à court terme, renforcera la responsabilité en matière de gestion des véhicules et garantira une réponse rapide aux besoins sur le terrain.

De ce qui précède, le Programme des Nations Unies recrute en urgence un chauffeur dédié pour appuyer le Département de la sûreté et de la sécurité (UNDSS)>

Tâches et Responsabilités

<Assurer des services de conduite fiables et sécurisés ainsi que l’entretien et la gestion des véhicules

- Conduire en toute sécurité les véhicules des Nations Unies pour transporter le personnel, les consultants et les délégations en visite vers et depuis les réunions, les missions sur le terrain, les ateliers et les événements à Yaoundé et dans d'autres régions.

- Veiller au respect des normes et règles de sûreté et de sécurité du Système des Nations Unies ;

- Conduire les staffs de l’UNDSS et assurer leurs déplacements aux réunions, rendez-vous, audiences, missions officielles)

- Assurer le contrôle de routine du véhicule (moteurs, freins, huiles et lubrifiants, pneumatique …) ;

- Maintenir le véhicule en parfait état de propreté ;

- S'assurer que l'entretien du véhicule, les visites techniques sont effectués dans les normes et délais requis;

- Rappeler les dates d’échéances des assurances afin qu’action de renouvellement soit prise.

- S'assurer que les dossiers du véhicule sont à jour et en conformité avec les lois en vigueur ;

- S’assurer que le carnet de bord du véhicule est convenablement rempli afin de faciliter l’élaboration des rapports mensuels d’utilisation du carburant.

- Suivre sur la base des outils appropriés la consommation des carburants et autres produits d’usages pour le fonctionnement du véhicule ;

- Distribuer le courrier ;

- Assurer l’acheminement des dossiers et faciliter toute liaison entre UNDSS et les partenaires

- Donner un appui dans l’organisation logistique des réunions et ateliers.

2. Conformité, sécurité et sûreté

- Respecter strictement les règles de sécurité et de sûreté des Nations Unies, y compris les directives de l'UNDSS et les restrictions de déplacement pendant les périodes critiques et à haut risque.

- Veiller à adopter des pratiques de conduite sûres et défensives, en respectant le code de la route local, les limitations de vitesse et les consignes de sécurité, en particulier lors de missions dans des régions sensibles ou éloignées.

- Rester vigilant face aux menaces potentielles pour la sécurité et signaler immédiatement tout incident ou quasi-accident au supérieur hiérarchique et à l'UNDSS, selon les besoins.

- Soutenir la mise en œuvre des plans d'urgence et d'évacuation lors des missions sur le terrain, en aidant le personnel et les visiteurs à garantir la sécurité et la continuité des opérations.

3. Assistance administrative et logistique

- Aider à la mise en place logistique des événements, y compris le chargement et le déchargement du matériel, l'aménagement des sièges ou la distribution des fournitures sur les lieux de formation ou lors des ateliers.

- Apporter un soutien dans les tâches administratives courantes, telles que la photocopie, l'envoi du courrier et la tenue d'un inventaire simple des documents relatifs aux véhicules (assurance, immatriculation, papiers d'inspection).

- Assurer la liaison avec les prestataires de services locaux (stations-service, garages, prestataires logistiques) avec l'autorisation du supérieur hiérarchique.

4. Soutenir les activités de coordination interagence

- Faire preuve d'une grande discrétion, fiabilité et intégrité, en particulier lors de l'accompagnement de hauts fonctionnaires.

- Soutenir une coordination efficace entre le PNUD et les autres agences dans le cadre du projet d'assistance technique conjoint, en assurant la cohérence logistique lors des missions conjointes, des visites de suivi et des réunions de coordination.

5. Autres tâches

- Effectuer toute autre tâche de conduite ou de logistique assignée par le chef de Département, l'Adjoint.

- Fournir un soutien en matière de conduite pour les missions conjointes des Nations Unies ou les réunions de coordination, comme l'exige la nature multi-agences du projet.

Le titulaire exécute d'autres tâches jugées nécessaires au fonctionnement efficace du Bureau et de l'Organisation

Compétences

Compétences clés:

Obtenir des résultats: NIVEAU 1: Se concentrer sur l’obtention de résultat de qualité et à impact. Toujours s’efforcer d’atteindre ou de dépasser les normes d’excellence

Sortir des sentiers battus / penser de

façon innovante: NIVEAU 1: Aller au-delà des approches conventionnelles et des méthodes établies

Apprendre sans arrêt / Apprentissage

permanent: NIVEAU 1: Rechercher activement des opportunités d’apprendre et de se perfectionner, aussi bien professionnellement que personnellement Se tenir au courant des nouvelles évolutions dans son domaine professionnel.

S’adapter tout en souplesse / S’adapter

et être flexible : NIVEAU 1: Accueillir tout changement avec flexibilité et adopter de nouvelles idées, approches et méthodes de travail

Agir avec détermination: NIVEAU 1: Poursuivre sa mission avec motivation et énergie

Collaborer et nouer des partenariats :NIVEAU 1: Faire preuve d’empathie et d’intelligence émotionnelle, en tenant compte des besoins et des sentiments des autres. / de chacun

Favoriser la diversité et l’inclusion: NIVEAU 1: Traiter tous les individus avec respect, prendre en compte les aspects éthiques et faire preuve de sensibilité vis-à-vis de toutes les spécificités de chacun

Compétences transversales et techniques

Administration & Opérations/ Gestion des Véhicules/ Connaître la politique et les procédures sur la gestion du parc de véhicules

Satisfaction client / Gestion de la clientèle / Être en mesure d’apporter une réponse rapide et appropriée, en tenant compte de l’urgence de la situation, de fournir des solutions cohérentes, et d’obtenir en temps voulu des résultats ou des solutions de qualité afin de bien appréhender et de satisfaire les besoins réels des clients. Contribuer à l’élaboration de la stratégie en matière de service client. Chercher des moyens d’apporter une valeur ajoutée par rapport aux demandes immédiates des clients. Savoir anticiper les besoins et les préoccupations futurs des clients.

Ethique /Connaissances en matière de politiques des Nations Unies – Ethique/ Connaître et comprendre le Statut et Règlement du personnel des Nations Unies et d’autres politiques relatives à l’éthique et l’intégrité

Communication/Communication/ Communiquer de manière claire, concise et sans équivoque, à la fois à l’écrit et à l’oral ; adapter les messages et choisir les modes de communication en fonction du public. Savoir gérer la communication interne et externe, au travers des médias, des réseaux sociaux et d’autres canaux appropriés. >

Compétences et expérience requises.

Education:

<Diplôme de fin de l'Enseignement secondaire avec un permis de conduire valide requis (Permis de conduire valide de catégorie « B » Minimum >

Experience:

<Au minimum 2 ans (diplôme de fin d'études secondaires) d'expérience professionnelle pertinente en tant que chauffeur avec un dossier de conduite sûr sont requis

- Avoir une bonne connaissance de la mécanique automobile (sera considéré comme un atout).

- Une expérience professionnelle dans un poste similaire avec les Nations Unies ou toute autre organisation internationale reconnue (ONG, Ministère, Organisation internationale) sera un plus.

- Expérience et connaissance de l'utilisation des radios VHF, HF, etc est un avantage.

- Expérience et connaissance des règles de bonne conduite et l'aptitude à effectuer des réparations mineures est un avantage.

- Une expérience préalable de la conduite de véhicules officiels et du transport de visiteurs officiels est un plus.

- Expérience et connaissance des procédures de sécurité routière et de la conduite défensive sera considérée comme un atout.

- Une capacité d’effectuer des formalités administratives relatives à la bonne tenue du véhicule en application des règles de gestion du parc automobile (Logbook, suivi dossier assurance, visite technique) est un plus.

- Expérience et bonne connaissance de la carte routière du Cameroun est un atout.

- Une familiarité avec les procédures et mesures de sécurité et sûreté des Nations Unies relatives à la conduite des missions sur terrain, est un avantage>

Principe d’égalité des chances

En tant qu’employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances, le PNUD valorise la diversité comme une expression de la multiplicité des nations et des cultures dans lesquelles nous intervenons. À ce titre, nous encourageons les candidats qualifiés, quels que soient leur origine ou leur parcours, à postuler aux postes au sein de l’organisation. Nos décisions en matière de recrutement sont fondées sur le mérite et l’adéquation au poste, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Le PNUD s’engage également à créer un environnement de travail inclusif où chaque membre du personnel est encouragé à contribuer à notre mission, est valorisé, peut s’épanouir professionnellement et bénéficier d’opportunités de carrière ouvertes à tous.

Harcèlement sexuel, exploitation et abus d'autorité

Le PNUD ne tolère ni le harcèlement, ni le harcèlement sexuel, ni l'exploitation, ni la discrimination, ni l'abus d'autorité. Tous les candidats retenus font donc l'objet de vérifications appropriées et sont tenus de respecter les normes et principes applicables.

Droit de sélectionner plusieurs candidats.

Le PNUD se réserve le droit de sélectionner un ou plusieurs candidats dans le cadre du présent avis de vacance de poste. Nous pouvons également conserver les candidatures et examiner les candidats ayant postulé à ce poste pour d’autres fonctions similaires au sein du PNUD, au même niveau de classification et comportant des exigences comparables en matière de description de poste, d’expérience et de formation.

les candidats sont invités à lire read UNDP’s guidance for candidates on using AI responsibly in UNDP recruitment and selection

Alerte à la fraude.

Le PNUD ne perçoit aucun frais à quelque étape que ce soit de son processus de recrutement. Pour plus d’informations, veuillez consulter : www.undp.org/scam-alert.

- Tier 3 or no tier indicated : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.

Background

General Assembly Resolution 2186 (XXI) decided to “bring into operations the United Nations Capital Development Fund as an organ of the General Assembly which shall function as an autonomous organization of the United Nations. The UN Capital Development Fund (UNCDF) assists developing countries, especially least developing countries, in the development of their economies by supplementing existing sources of capital assistance by means of grants, loans, and guarantees. UNCDFs vision is to help mobilize and catalyze an increase of capital flows for SDG impactful investments to Member States to address the most pressing development challenges facing vulnerable communities in these countries and thereby contribute to sustainable economic growth and equitable prosperity.

As a Flagship Catalytic Blended Financing platform of the UN, UNCDF utilizes its unique capability in the UN system to deploy grants, loans and guarantees to crowd-in finance for the scaling of development impact. UNCDF focuses on where the needs are greatest, a deliberate focus and capability rooted in UNCDF’s unique investment mandate to support the achievement of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and the realization of the Doha Programme of Action for the least developed countries, 2022–2031.

As per its Strategic Framework, UNCDF works to deploy its functions as a hybrid development organization and development finance institution. UNCDF responds to Member States requests for assistance by providing targeted technical and financial advisory services on investments for development outcomes, designing bespoke financial structuring solutions, undertaking financial derisking of investments, and enhancing investment readiness of SDG aligned projects in partnership with private sector, United Nations Organizations, International and Local Finance Institutions, Development Finance Institutions as well as Foundations and Philanthropy, among others. UNCDF works to develop local financial systems, new markets and mobilize and crowd in capital from public and private sources. UNCDF is driven by a partnership mindset which enables it to deploy its different capital capabilities in highly tailored and responsive ways in order to mobilize investments flows from other sources, in particular from the private sector. By structuring transactions which are highly impactful, but also recognize the need for multiplying the impact of its own capital, UNCDF seeks to position itself as a preferred partner for different stakeholders. UNCDF’s work is focused on three priority areas, including:

• SME Finance

• Sub-National Finance

• Digital Finance

UNCDF’s organizational set up includes an Investment and Implementation Division (IID), Investment and Finance Oversight Division (IFOD), Operations and Oversight Division (OOD) and a Directorate of the Executive Office. UNCDF staff and personnel are located in regional hubs based in Dakar (Senegal), Nairobi (Kenya) and Bangkok (Thailand) with sub-regional presence in a number of locations in the Caribbean and Pacific Regions. UNCDF is led by an Executive Secretary based out of New York, USA. Pursuant to General Assembly resolution 2321(XXII, para 1.a), the Administrator of the UNDP performs the function of the Managing Director of UNCDF. UNCDF is overseen by an Executive Board comprised of UN Member States.

The Programme Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating activities, projects, or programmes across teams or partners, plan, organize and monitor implementation, and will serve as a focal point for coordination across programme in Ethiopia.

This role will involve managing projects and programmes in alignment with the country's strategic goals and work plans, ensuring quality standards, and achieving targeted outcomes. The coordinator will actively support the implementation of the projects through UNCDF’s financial tools and grow the project portfolio focusing on segments like Micro, Small, and Medium-sized Enterprises (MSMEs) and sectors such as fintech, ag-tech and climate-tech.

Key responsibilities include managing personnel, building strategic partnerships, advising government entities, and engaging with financial service providers. The Programme Coordinator will support the resource mobilization, knowledge sharing, and communication efforts to sustain and expand UNCDF’s visibility and impact in Ethiopia.

UNCDF adopts a portfolio approach to accommodate changing business needs and leverage linkages across interventions to achieve its strategic goals. Therefore, UNCDF personnel are expected to work across units, functions, teams, and projects in multidisciplinary teams in order to enhance and enable horizontal collaboration.

Duties and Responsibilities

The Programme Coordinator will hold supervisory responsibilities for staff and non-staff project personnel, including consultants engaged under the project, and will provide direction, guidance and oversight to all such personnel. As well as provide guidance and oversight to other non-staff personnel.

1. Ensure Effective Programme Coordination for projects in Ethiopia

• Plan strategically and support the development of country strategies, work plans, and programme priorities

• Coordinate the implementation of UNCDF programmes in line with annual work plans, ensuring quality assurance and achievement of outputs.

• Monitor projects’ milestones and outputs, tracking performance, and implementing corrective actions as needed

• Provide strategic oversight of planning, budgeting, implementing, and monitoring of the projects in Ethiopia tracking use of financial resources in accordance with UNCDF/ UNDP rules and regulations.

• Conduct timely project reviews, revisions and complete related reporting obligations, in accordance with UNDP/ UNCDF policies, UN rules and regulations as well as applicable donors' requirements

2. Establish, strengthen and maintain strategic partnerships, contribute to resource mobilization, and engage effectively with donors

• Establish, strengthen and maintain strategic partnerships with local and regional stakeholders, including government ministries, regulators, donors, financial institutions, and development partners. This function is pivotal in supporting UNCDF’s resource mobilization efforts by cultivating relationships with funders at national, regional, and global levels, securing funding for both existing and new initiatives.

• Create a robust network of allies and funding sources, explore and identify new partnerships and funding opportunities to ensure the long-term sustainability and scaling of UNCDF’s interventions.

• Provide advisory support to government entities, regulators, and private sector stakeholders to promote policies and frameworks that foster effective engagement in Ethiopia.

• Collaborate with the regional office team to position and advocate for goals and objectives central to UNCDF’s mandate.

3. Ensure provision of leadership and management

• Foster a collaborative and high-performance environment through regular feedback, professional development opportunities, and capacity-building initiatives to empower project managers

• Manage project managers and coordinate with colleagues across different functional areas such as operations, finance, and technical teams, to meet project objectives.

4. Facilitate knowledge management and result measurement

• Oversee result measurement and knowledge management activities to document and share lessons learned, best practices, and insights from UNCDF’s projects in Ethiopia.

• Support results measurement by working closely with the Performance Management Support Unit (PMSU) and the Regional Market Systems Development and Impact Specialist to track and evaluate project impact against established benchmarks and targets.

• Coordinate with UNDP and other UN agencies to align efforts, promote synergies, and integrate UNCDF’s work within broader UN development frameworks, enhancing the collective impact of the UN’s presence in Ethiopia.

• Lead the identification and formulation lessons learned and recommendations to improve delivery and build on the thought leadership needs of the country

The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization.

Competencies

Core competencies:

Achieve Results: LEVEL 3: Set and align challenging, achievable objectives for multiple projects, have lasting impact

Think Innovatively: LEVEL 3: Proactively mitigate potential risks, develop new ideas to solve complex problems

Learn Continuously: LEVEL 3: Create and act on opportunities to expand horizons, diversify experiences

Adapt with Agility: LEVEL 3: Proactively initiate and champion change, manage multiple competing demands

Act with Determination: LEVEL 3: Think beyond immediate task/barriers and take action to achieve greater results

Engage and Partner: LEVEL 3: Political savvy, navigate complex landscape, champion inter-agency collaboration

Enable Diversity and Inclusion: LEVEL 3: Appreciate benefits of diverse workforce and champion inclusivity

Ability to use objective problem analysis and judgement to understand how interrelated elements coexist within an overall process or system, and to consider how altering one element can impact on other parts of the system

Digital

Set up the processes and structures to design, testing and implement new financial mechanisms. Managing outreach and stakeholder engagement

Required Skills and Experience

Education:

• A first-level university degree (Bachelor’s degree) in the areas mentioned above in combination with an additional two years of qualifying experience will be given due consideration in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Background

Este processo seletivo busca contratar profissionais para atuar de forma compartilhada no apoio técnico e operacional de duas iniciativas estratégicas desenvolvidas no âmbito da parceria de cooperação técnica internacional entre o Programa das Nações Unidas para o Desenvolvimento (PNUD) e o Conselho Nacional de Justiça (CNJ):

- Justiça 4.0: o Programa, iniciado em 2020, visa desenvolver e aprimorar soluções tecnológicas para tornar os serviços oferecidos pela Justiça brasileira mais eficientes, eficazes e acessíveis à população, além de otimizar a gestão processual para magistrados(as), servidores(as), advogados(as) e demais atores do sistema de Justiça. O Justiça 4.0 é um dos maiores programas de transformação digital do Poder Judiciário e também dialoga com os Objetivos de Desenvolvimento Sustentável e com a Agenda 2030 da ONU.

- Justiça [+Segura]: firmado em 2025, o Programa foca no fortalecimento da segurança cibernética no Poder Judiciário. O Justiça [+Segura] desenvolve e implementa ferramentas e estratégias para o fortalecimento da segurança cibernética, da preservação digital e da integridade da informação, ampliando a proteção dos sistemas e dos usuários do Judiciário. A iniciativa fortalece a segurança institucional e promove a transparência, a boa governança e a eficiência dos processos judiciais, contribuindo para a economia de recursos e para uma atuação mais ágil da Justiça em benefício dos cidadãos e da sociedade. Nesse cenário, o(a) profissional integrará a equipe compartilhada dos programas, atuando sob a supervisão direta da Unidade de Gestão de Projetos do PNUD e em estreita articulação com as coordenações técnicas do CNJ, com o propósito de garantir a excelência operacional, a sinergia entre as ações e o alcance dos resultados pactuados.

Duties and Responsibilities

O(a) Assistente de Comunicação integrará a equipe de Comunicação dos programas Justiça 4.0 e Justiça [+Segura], em estreita colaboração com o Conselho Nacional de Justiça, o Programa das Nações Unidas para o Desenvolvimento e demais parceiros institucionais. Atuará no planejamento e na execução de ações de comunicação voltadas a iniciativas de tecnologia, inovação e segurança cibernética no Poder Judiciário, com propostas criativas e inovadoras e produção de conteúdos originais em diferentes formatos e para múltiplas plataformas com foco em alcance e impacto, assim como atividades de editoração para viabilizar publicação de conteúdos produzidos pelas equipes técnicas. Com perfil propositivo e aprofundamento nas temáticas dos programas, o(a) profissional deverá aplicar linguagem comunicacional de modo a traduzir temas complexos em produtos acessíveis, contribuindo para a construção de narrativas consistentes, claras e baseadas em evidências. Além da produção de conteúdo, o(a) profissional deverá apoiar a equipe de Comunicação e as áreas técnicas do programa nos processos de finalização editorial de produtos de conhecimento, incluindo o acompanhamento dos fluxos de editoração de manuais, guias, cartilhas, folders e materiais correlatos — desde a organização dos textos e insumos até a finalização das publicações, em articulação com empresas terceirizadas parceiras, designers e demais envolvidos. Também apoiará a produção de boletins periódicos de registros das atividades dos programas.

O(a) titular da vaga desempenhará outras funções dentro do seu perfil funcional, como a participação em reuniões periódicas em formato online, cobertura de eventos em formato online e presencial (quando necessário), interface com instituições parceiras e tarefas administrativas e de monitoramento de mídia, além das atividades abaixo detalhadas. A posição será exercida em regime remoto, sendo requisito que o(a) candidato(a) tenha residência no Brasil. Quando houver necessidade de cobertura presencial de eventos, poderão ser realizadas viagens nacionais, com as despesas correspondentes custeadas pelo projeto.

1. Cooperar para a comunicação externa e produção de conteúdo institucional

- Propor pautas e criar conteúdos originais em diferentes formatos, como matérias, artigos, releases, entrevistas, roteiros de vídeo e legendas;

- Produzir conteúdo para diferentes plataformas, incluindo sites, redes sociais, folders, relatórios, e-books, boletins, podcasts e newsletters;

- Difundir e fortalecer as entregas e os impactos dos programas junto a magistrados(as), atores do Judiciário, servidores(as) e público em geral;

- Traduzir a produção técnica dos programas — como ferramentas, soluções digitais, normativas, manuais e guias para linguagem comunicacional acessível e criativa;

- Apoiar a equipe de comunicação na apuração de informações junto aos núcleos técnicos e parceiros para produção de peças de comunicação.

2. Cooperar para a comunicação interna e sistematização de informações

- Elaborar produtos de comunicação interna a partir de insumos técnicos produzidos pelas equipes dos programas;

- Produzir relatórios de entrega, boletins periódicos, apresentações e outros materiais destinados ao reporte de informações à equipe e às coordenações;

- Apoiar a apuração, sistematização e apresentação de dados relacionados às atividades dos programas;

- Participar de reuniões e eventos remotos ou presenciais (quando solicitado) relacionados às temáticas do Programa.

3. Contribuir para o relacionamento com imprensa e monitoramento de mídia

- Propor pautas e apoiar atividades de assessoria de imprensa, tanto proativa quanto reativa, conforme demanda;

- Monitorar conteúdos de mídia relacionados aos temas de interesse dos programas;

- Produzir relatórios de monitoramento de mídia para apoiar a análise estratégica de comunicação;

- Contribuir para o fortalecimento da narrativa institucional e do posicionamento público dos programas.

4. Contribuir para a Comunicação estratégica e advocacy

- Colaborar com o mapeamento de demandas e oportunidades de comunicação e advocacy junto às equipes dos programas;

- Contribuir para a elaboração de planos de comunicação e executar as ações propostas, em linha com o planejamento da equipe;

- Apoiar a interlocução com diferentes atores envolvidos nas atividades de comunicação e advocacy dos programas.

5. Projetos especiais e inovação em comunicação

- Apoiar o desenvolvimento de projetos especiais em comunicação e advocacy;

- Propor a utilização de novos canais e ferramentas de divulgação em massa para ampliar o alcance das ações dos programas;

- Desenvolver conteúdos especiais relacionados a momentos de fechamento de ciclos ou de gestão, considerando sua atuação nacional e local.

6. Assessorar a produção editorial e gestão de publicações institucionais

- Atuar no recebimento de conteúdos técnicos e na articulação de fluxos entre equipes técnicas, comunicação e PNUD;

- Acionar e acompanhar serviços de revisão, diagramação e impressão de publicações institucionais;

- Acompanhar prazos, ajustes e qualidade editorial, garantindo aderência à identidade visual institucional;

- Revisar correções e apoiar a elaboração de textos institucionais, como prefácios e apresentações;

- Acompanhar a entrega final de produtos editoriais, incluindo impressão e processos de pagamento de prestadores de serviço junto ao PNUD;

- Apoiar fluxos de tradução de publicações para versões em inglês e espanhol;

- Realizar levantamentos junto às equipes técnicas sobre previsão de produtos e lançamentos editoriais.

7. Contribuir para a gestão do conhecimento e disseminação de informações institucionais

- Apoiar a sistematização, organização e disseminação de conhecimentos produzidos pelos programas, contribuindo para sua acessibilidade e utilização pelas equipes e partes interessadas;

- Apoiar a elaboração e atualização de produtos de conhecimento, incluindo relatórios, boletins, apresentações, registros de boas práticas, estudos de caso e materiais de referência institucional;

- Contribuir para a organização de informações e conteúdos relacionados às entregas dos programas, apoiando a preservação da memória institucional e o compartilhamento de conhecimentos entre equipes e parceiros.

O titular desempenha outras funções dentro do seu perfil funcional que considere necessárias ao bom funcionamento do Projeto.

Arranjo Institucional

O/a Assistente de Comunicação integrará a equipe de Comunicação dos programas, e estará submetido/a à supervisão direta da Analista de Gestão em Educação Institucional e Comunicação.

Competências

Competências Essenciais

Alcançar Resultados: NÍVEL 1: Planeja e monitora seu próprio trabalho, presta atenção aos detalhes e entrega um trabalho de qualidade dentro do prazo.

Pensar de forma Inovadora: NÍVEL 1: Aberto a ideias criativas e riscos conhecidos, é um solucionador de problemas prático e faz melhorias.

Aprender Continuamente: NÍVEL 1: Mente aberta e curioso, compartilha conhecimento, aprende com os erros e pede feedback.

Adaptar com Agilidade: NÍVEL 1: Adapta-se às mudanças, lida de forma construtiva com ambiguidades e incertezas, e é flexível.

Agir com Determinação: NÍVEL 1: Demonstra determinação e motivação, mantém a calma diante da adversidade e tem confiança.

Engajar e fazer Parcerias: NÍVEL 1: Demonstra compaixão e compreensão em relação aos outros, formando relacionamentos positivos.

Promover a Diversidade e Inclusão: NÍVEL 1: Valoriza e respeita as diferenças, está consciente de vieses inconscientes e enfrenta a discriminação.

Competências multifuncionais e técnicas

Direção e Estratégia de Negócios | Pensamento Estratégico

Desenvolver estratégias eficazes e planos prioritários alinhados com a missão e os objetivos do PNUD, baseando-se em uma análise sistêmica de desafios, oportunidades e riscos potenciais; conectar a visão geral à realidade no campo para criar soluções tangíveis e direcionadas; aprender a partir de diversas fontes para antecipar e responder de forma eficaz às tendências atuais e futuras; demonstrar capacidade de previsão.

Direção e Estratégia de Negócio | Perspicácia Empresarial

Capacidade de compreender e lidar com situações de negócios de forma a alcançar bons resultados. Habilidade para tomar boas decisões e fazer julgamentos rápidos dentro de tais contextos. Conhecimento e compreensão dos marcos operacionais da organização.

Desenvolvimento de Negócios | Geração de Conhecimento

Capacidade de pesquisar informações e transformá-las em conhecimento útil, relevante para o contexto ou que responda a uma necessidade específica. Capacidade de aplicar conceitos existentes a novas situações e desenvolver novos conceitos para gerar soluções viáveis e novas abordagens. Conhecimento de conceitos relevantes, modelos conceituais e teorias que podem ser úteis para lidar com novas situações.

Desenvolvimento de Negócios | Facilitação de Conhecimento

Capacidade de engajar indivíduos e grupos, tanto internamente quanto externamente, e de projetar e facilitar atividades para compartilhar e trocar conhecimentos, informações e ideias. Conhecimento de ferramentas e abordagens que estimulam a participação ativa, a contribuição e o intercâmbio.

Agenda 2030: Engajamento e Eficácia

Inovação Ecossistema de Inovação.

Digital | Design de Produtos Digitais

Capacidade de projetar produtos digitais que sejam centrados no usuário, intuitivos, funcionais e que alcancem os resultados desejados.

Digital | Mídias Sociais

Conhecimento de mídias sociais e capacidade de aconselhar sobre seu uso para alcançar resultados de desenvolvimento.

Habilidades e experiência necessárias

Requisitos mínimos de educação:

- Diploma do Ensino Médio é requerido.

- Diploma Universitário (Ensino Superior) em Comunicação Social, Jornalismo, Rádio&TV, Multimeios, Marketing ou áreas afins será dada a devida consideração, mas não é um requisito.

Anos mínimos de experiência profissional relevante:

- Mínimo de 5 anos (para Ensino Médio) ou 2 anos (para Ensino Superior) de experiência profissional na área de comunicação, incluindo produção de conteúdos multiformatos em contexto jornalístico e/ou institucional, incluindo mídias digitais.

Habilidades necessárias:

- Experiência no uso do pacote Office 365;

- Experiência na utilização de mídias sociais e novas tecnologias aplicadas à comunicação digital, tais como Canva e plataformas de disparo de e-mail marketing.

Habilidades desejadas, além das competências abordadas na seção Competências

- Experiência em projetos, instituições e entidades relacionadas com a temática da tecnologia, inovação, segurança cibernética e/ou tecnologia da informação;

- Experiência na atuação com atores do Poder Judiciário;

- Experiência com clipping de notícias e monitoramento de mídia;

- Experiência comprovada em redação jornalística e/ou comunicação institucional; e

- Experiência em Comunicação Institucional para órgãos públicos e privados.

Idiomas exigidos

- Fluência em português é requerido. Nível básico de inglês é desejável.
